suritch - sport watch band for apple wat.name: SURITCH - Sport Watch Band for Apple Watch Ultra 4/3/2/1 49mm Soft Silicone Shockproof Rugged Protective Strap with Case - Starlight
suritch - sport watch band for apple wat.description: This SURITCH integrated sport band with protective case is exclusively designed for 49mm Apple Watch Ultra 4/3/2/1. Built with dual-layer flexible TPU and reinforced PC structure, it absorbs shocks and prevents deformation, and raised bezels effectively protect the screen from bumps and scratches. Made of premium soft TPU and TPE blended material, the strap offers skin-friendly comfort for all-day wear during work, sports and daily rest. It fits wrist sizes from 16.5cm to 22cm, paired with durable stainless steel pin for easy adjustment to secure a snug fit even in active scenarios. The snap-on design allows simple installation and removal, and precise cutouts ensure full access to all buttons, sensors and normal wireless charging, keeping all watch functions intact.
